message.subject: PH-100: two-year commitment and cost transparency
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

We value our long partnership and want a sustainable agreement rather than a blanket increase. In return for a 24-month commitment at 4,000 housings per year, we propose EUR 49.13 per unit, payment 60 days net, effective 1 April 2027; lead time 35 days and FCA remain unchanged.

Please share your current full cost per housing, broken down into materials, energy, labour and overhead, together with the changes behind your request and your annual financing rate. We will use this to find a price that supports a healthy foundry; if 30-day payment materially helps, please quantify the price reduction you could exchange for it.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Opening anchor trades two-year volume security; request full cost to establish sustainable pricing before settling.

trace.final_text: Counter-offer sent; requested a cost breakdown to support sustainable pricing.

message.subject: SH-220: 24-month award proposal
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you. We are awarding one supplier for 6,000 shafts per year over 24 months, with two bidders under consideration. To make your offer competitive, I propose either €14.26/unit, payment 30 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW; or €14.80/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
We can allow 35 rather than 28 days for scheduling flexibility; the second package also offers faster payment in exchange for delivered pricing. Which package can you approve for the full award?
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

message.subject: SH-220: competitive award and delivery requirement
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you. We are selecting one supplier for 6,000 shafts annually over 24 months from two bidders. Your standard 45-day lead time cannot meet our maximum of 42 days; our production requirement is 35 days.
Please consider either €13.91/unit, payment 45 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW; or €14.41/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP. The second package offers faster cash collection in exchange for delivered pricing. Please confirm which package you can support for the full award and whether you can commit to 35-day delivery.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Anchor competitive full-award pricing with alternative equivalent-cost structures; offer scheduling flexibility to J1 and faster payment option to both. C1 must correct noncompliant lead time.

trace.final_text: Counteroffers sent to both suppliers, with alternative payment and delivery packages.

message.subject: PH-100: revised alternatives and sustainable margin
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for moving on price and accepting the two-year term and April start. We can raise our proposal to EUR 50.33 per unit with payment 60 days net, or EUR 49.94 per unit with payment 30 days net; both are for 24 months, effective 1 April 2027, with 4,000 units annually, 35-day lead time and FCA unchanged.

Our opening was a negotiating proposal, not a claim based on external index data. I respect the confidentiality of your detailed breakdown: could you instead confirm your total full cost per housing and financing rate, or the minimum price that would leave a 4% operating margin on each payment option? A confidential aggregate figure is sufficient to help us protect continuity without underwriting an unexplained blanket increase.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Reciprocate substantial movement with cost-neutral payment alternatives; cost data absent for demo supplier, request confidential aggregate sustainability figure.

trace.final_text: Revised alternatives sent, with a request for confidential sustainability figures.

message.subject: SH-220: volume confirmation and revised proposal
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you for the substantial move and for confirming DAP and 35-day delivery. The award covers 6,000 shafts per year for 24 months; that is the volume basis we can commit to for the selected supplier.
My target is a commercial award target, not a claim about your manufacturing costs; I do not have a verified cost breakdown to send you. In return for your move, I can raise our proposal to €15.13/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP, retaining the faster payment you value.
Can you approve this package against the full-volume award?
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: J1 moved materially and selected fast payment. Make a limited reciprocal price concession, answer request honestly, and confirm mandate volume without invented cost evidence.

trace.final_text: Revised offer sent to Demo Drehteile, confirming annual volume and retaining 14-day payment.

message.subject: SH-220: planning basis and competitive revision
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for confirming 35-day delivery. The selected supplier receives 6,000 units annually for 24 months; I cannot commit to a higher volume, and exact release dates must be aligned with production rather than invented now.
The competing SH-220 offer is €16.10/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP (offer:DEMO-J1-1), so your €16.70 package is not competitive.
My earlier figure is a commercial negotiation target, not a verified manufacturing-cost estimate. Our proposal remains €14.41/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP; alternatively, to remove delivery logistics from your scope, €13.82/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW. Please review the full-volume award and fast-payment benefit with your approver and return your best achievable package.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: C1 corrected compliance but raised total cost; hold target rather than bid against ourselves, offer EXW/fast-payment alternative and verified rival leverage. Do not promise unsupported higher volume or binding release dates.

trace.final_text: Asked Demo Machining to improve its offer against the verified competing quote.

message.subject: SH-220: narrowing the remaining price gap
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you for reducing the price again. The committed award volume remains 6,000 shafts per year over 24 months; I cannot promise additional demand.
To reciprocate your move, I can increase our proposal to €15.29/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP. This keeps the planning security and fast payment intact. Please see whether you can close the remaining gap on that basis so we can conclude the award.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Smaller reciprocal concession after J1's second price reduction; preserve favorable terms and avoid unsupported volume increase.

trace.final_text: Sent a smaller price concession to Demo Drehteile while retaining the agreed delivery and payment terms.

message.subject: PH-100: narrowing the remaining gap
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for the further reduction. We respect your decision to keep your calculation confidential and will not ask again.

To make the 30-day payment option work, we can improve our proposal to EUR 50.62 per unit, payment 30 days net, a 24-month contract effective 1 April 2027. Annual volume remains 4,000 units, with 35-day lead time and FCA unchanged.

This pairs your preferred payment terms with two years of planned demand. Can you approve this package so we can conclude the agreement?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Smaller reciprocal concession, focusing on supplier-preferred 30-day payment. Provisional cost proxy uncertain; no further attempts to force disclosure.

trace.final_text: Sent a revised €50.62 proposal on the supplier’s preferred 30-day payment terms.

message.subject: PH-100: proposal to conclude
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your further concession. We are now very close, and I can make one smaller movement to EUR 50.75 per unit, payment 30 days net, for 24 months effective 1 April 2027. The annual volume of 4,000 units, 35-day lead time and FCA remain unchanged.

If you can approve this final small adjustment, we are ready to accept the matching offer and conclude our two-year agreement.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Supplier remains open and made another concession; offer a small shrinking step in exchange for closure, with no renewed confidential-data request.

trace.final_text: Sent a €50.75 closing proposal with all other terms unchanged.

message.subject: SH-220: proposal to conclude
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you; we are now very close. I can make one further small move to €15.38/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP, for 6,000 shafts annually over 24 months.
If you confirm this package, I am ready to conclude the award without another negotiating round. Can we settle on this basis?
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Further shrinking concession with credible commitment to conclude if accepted; J1 is still open and has moved each round.

trace.final_text: Sent Demo Drehteile a €15.38 closing proposal with a commitment to conclude if accepted.

message.subject: SH-220: final competitive review
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for the revised alternatives. The competing SH-220 offer has now reduced to €15.50/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP (offer:DEMO-J1-3), leaving your delivered package materially above it.
To give you a realistic opportunity for the full award, I can revise our proposal to €15.28/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP, for 6,000 units annually over 24 months. Please confirm whether your approver can support this package; if not, I understand your position and will proceed with the competitive offer.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Give weaker bidder a final realistic competitive target below J1 current standing cost while J1 closing proposal is pending.

trace.final_text: Sent Demo Machining a final competitive proposal for the full award.
Accepted: €50.75 per unit, 30-day payment, 24 months, effective 1 April 2027.

batch.note: Accept J1 final offer: EUR 15.40, 14-day payment, 35-day lead time, DAP. Total EUR 187217.07, lowest compliant standing offer. C1 remains materially more expensive; further pushing J1 risks losing its final offer for a negligible remaining gap.

trace.final_text: Accepted Demo Drehteile’s final offer: €15.40/unit, DAP, 14-day payment and 35-day lead time; total cost €187,217.07.
